slices.title: Add OHDER entropy snapshot engine
slices.description: Create a deterministic engine that converts architect status, previous architecture score, drift analytics, and policy thresholds into entropy telemetry and refactor pressure.
acceptanceCriteria: Healthy architect status returns low entropyScore and refactorPressure none.
High replayability risk increases entropyScore and refactorPressure.
Low architecture score increases entropyScore and refactorPressure.
Regressing drift analytics sets trend regressing.
Architecture score deltas are deterministic when previous architect status is available.

slices.title: Capture entropy during slice close
slices.description: Make ask slice close persist OHDER entropy history and emit replayable entropy events after architect assessment.
acceptanceCriteria: Successful slice close emits EntropyImpactMeasured.
Successful slice close emits EntropyTrendChanged.
Metrics history includes entropy, coupling, replayability risk, architecture score, entropyScore, and source slice-close.
Drift analytics are recomputed after slice-close entropy capture.
Entropy capture does not block otherwise successful slice close.

slices.title: Make OHDER next use entropy trends
slices.description: Upgrade OHDER next-action decisions so worsening entropy trend or refactor pressure can recommend refactor or governance validation when no task is ready.
acceptanceCriteria: Active and ready tasks still take precedence over entropy recommendations.
High entropy refactor pressure returns create-refactor-slice.
Regressing entropy trend returns create-refactor-slice.
Medium entropy refactor pressure returns run-governance-validation.
Healthy entropy keeps await-new-requirement.
ask next output and OhderNextActionRecommended event include compact entropy summary.

slices.title: Document OHDER entropy runtime
slices.description: Update README and operations docs so operators understand entropy history, entropy events, refactor pressure, and ask next trend behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: README explains OHDER Entropy Runtime and slice-close entropy capture.
Runtime architecture docs map entropy capture to the 16-step OHDER loop.
Operator playbooks explain EntropyImpactMeasured, EntropyTrendChanged, refactorPressure, and ask metrics show --history.
Policy reference documents entropy thresholds or defaults used by OHDER next actions.
Full test suite and ASK pre-push check pass after documentation updates.
